entities.summary: Heinz Valk is an Estonian artist, caricaturist and politician. He is credited for coining the term "Singing Revolution" and its slogan "One day, no matter what, we will win!" some of the most famous and prophetic sentences describing the Estonians' non-violent freedom fight in 1988–1991 against the then Soviet occupation regime, which eventually was indeed successful as Estonians "won" when the country restored its full independence in August 1991.
